primer: State Street SPDR S&P Insurance ETF (KIE) holds 54 equal-weight US insurers and brokers (~2% cap) at a 0.35% fee and 0.02% spread. Sleeves span P&C (56.29%), Life & Health (19.89%), Brokers (14.05%), Reinsurance (7.88%), and Multi-Line (1.89%). At $65.38 on Nov 24, 2026, KIE trades at 11.06x P/E (10.75x FY1) and 1.45x P/B in a Stage 2 VCP squeeze (-2.71% off its $67.20 high). Pass 1 locked quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL given -10% property rate cuts, $9.3B casualty reserve drag, and a SPY Downtrend (27.8% breadth, 10 distribution days). We rate new capital WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_2, $62.72–$65.47 zone, $61.23 stop, $73.50 Base), confirm NOT_HELD (0 shares), and hold 100% of US cash ($7,290.91) in CASH.
